Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: What you might be wondering
Faq.a1: Sessions are held over a secure video connection at a pre-arranged appointment time.
Faq.a2: After your appointment request, payment and coordination are handled via WhatsApp.
Faq.a3: Yes. All sessions are kept confidential in line with professional ethics and data-protection law.
Faq.a4: No. The service is psychological counseling and guidance; it does not include medical diagnosis, treatment, or medication advice. Referrals to relevant specialists are made when necessary.
Faq.q5: What should I do in an emergency?
Faq.a5: In emergencies please call 112. This platform is not suitable for crisis/emergency intervention.

Crisis.body: If you have thoughts of harming yourself or others, please call emergency services (112) immediately. This platform is not suitable for emergency or crisis intervention.

Home.heroSubtitle: Online individual psychological counseling and guidance with an expert counselor. In a safe and confidential setting, at a time that suits you.

Home.trust3Body: Online sessions from anywhere, with flexible appointment times.
